mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread on a diesel truck forum aimed at King main thrust bearings. Title is framed as a warning to other builders rather than a single-user question.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Builder received King SI main shells reported as crushed and twisted in production so they would not seat in the block, plus machining shavings and oil found in the rod-bearing shrink wrap. Reads as a genuine production-defect report.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch redirected to a tollbit.nastyz28.com mirror instead of returning page content; could not read within the Step 0 fetch budget.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: BMW owner reports King STDX thrust bearings measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit S85 and S65 blocks. Dimensional out-of-spec claim on a specific part number.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch redirected to a tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning page content; could not read within the Step 0 fetch budget.

mentions.title: King Bearings Quality?
mentions.snippet: Mopar forum thread where a 2024-dated King main bearing was measured out of spec on free spread and recommended for return, with a 2025-dated bearing reportedly showing the same issue. Credible fault report spanning two production years.
mentions.replyNote: Thread is readable and still open; no King or official brand response has been posted and it is not locked or marked resolved.

mentions.title: King Bearing Failures?
mentions.snippet: King main and rod bearings reported to have failed during initial startup and break-in with metal and debris in the oil filter. Other posters in the thread report no trouble, so the claim is contested.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received a King XP set with mismatched sizes (8 uppers, 7 lowers in one size, 1 lower in another) and complains King redirected them to the supplier instead of helping. Service complaint as much as a product one.
